reasoning: The icon depicts a classic 3.5-inch floppy disk (angled corner, upper rectangular shutter, lower circular hub). It is universally recognized both as the universal metaphor for saving/backing up data and literally as retro floppy media, though at tiny sizes the circle-in-square layout resembles a front-load washing machine or an SD card.
